Brief: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered. — about Other discoveries

Kept:

2. In 2022 Hubble detected the light of the farthest individual star ever seen to date.
3. The star, WHL0137-LS (nicknamed Earendel), existed within the first billion years after the Big Bang.
